name: Sky Striker Ace - Purple Danya
effect:
This card is unaffected by your opponent’s card effects while on the field.
If a “Prototype Sky Striker Ace” monster leaves the field while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of “Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya” once per turn.
You can only activate each of the following effects of “Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya” once per duel:
- If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 “Sky Striker” card from your Deck to your hand.
- If your opponent activates a card or effect while this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can send this card to the GY; negate that effect.
- (Quick Effect): You can Link Summon 1 “Prototype Sky Striker Ace” monster from your Extra Deck, using cards from your field.  You can only use this of “Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya” once per Duel.
